name: pricemirror
description: Compare supplier offers in a saved, editable price mirror in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Turn supplier offers into a saved, editable side-by-side comparison in ChatGPT. Pricemirror helps construction, procurement and project teams compare prices, included work, exclusions, options and commercial terms.

Attach offer documents or use originals already saved in your account. Pricemirror extracts the selected documents and reads offer photos with visual AI, then generates and saves the comparison using its existing infrastructure. Follow progress and review the editable result directly in the chat, with Excel and PDF export controls. Open the full workspace when you prefer to manage offers and comparisons in the interface.

Connect your account or create one during connection. Your account permissions apply.

Reading quality depends on the supplied documents and their legibility. Check prices, handwritten changes and scope differences against the originals before using a comparison for a business decision. Missing or unreadable information may prevent a complete comparison.
defaultPrompt: Compare these supplier offers, including handwritten changes, exclusions and optional prices.
Export my selected price mirror as Excel and PDF.

positive.description: Show only the connected account's saved price mirrors and open its workspace.
positive.prompt: Open my Pricemirror workspace and show my saved price mirrors.
positive.expected_behavior: The embedded workspace opens and lists only records available to the authenticated account. An empty account receives a useful empty state. No offer or price mirror is created. The read-only opening tool mounts the existing website interface. Its subsequent authenticated website loading uses the same account and allowance logic as the normal website.

positive.description: Import the two verified synthetic PNG offer photos from assets/review, attached by the reviewer.
positive.prompt: Save these two attached PNG supplier offer photos to my Pricemirror account.
positive.expected_behavior: Each original PNG is imported into the authenticated account with a distinct requestId and status original. No OCR or additional model is invoked. Repeating the same import requestId does not create another offer or charge again. Invalid files produce an actionable error.

positive.description: In a fresh chat, attach both synthetic PNG offers and mention only Pricemirror. This case tests direct creation without an extra creation command; use a separate chat from the import-only case.
positive.expected_behavior: The bare plugin mention plus both supplier attachments starts one comparison directly in chat. Call pricemirror_create once with both files, a fresh requestId and no invented customInstructions; do not open the workspace or import the files separately first. The server checks the account allowance, extracts both originals, reads photos with visual AI, generates and durably saves the comparison. The inline card shows progress and switches to the saved editable result. After creation starts, call pricemirror_get_generation with the same requestId and waitForCompletion: true; repeat bounded waits while pending without interim narration or a duplicate card. Confirm completion only after a saved mirror is returned. Failed, cancelled, expired or interrupted runs are not success. Repeating the same requestId and identical inputs reuses the attempt without another comparison charge. Unreadable prices remain explicitly unknown. ChatGPT does not analyze the offers or generate comparison HTML.

positive.description: After positive case 3 has completed, revise that saved comparison using its original offers. Keep the original result available to verify that the new version does not overwrite it.
positive.prompt: Revise this comparison without window sills; keep the separate cash discount calculation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call pricemirror_revise once with exactly one source identifier from case 3 (mirrorId or sourceRequestId), a fresh requestId and the user's changeRequest. No new attachment is needed. Pricemirror retrieves the original offers, saved instructions and previous table privately, then generates and durably saves a separate version using the normal comparison allowance. The original remains unchanged and the document language is preserved. The inline card shows the new result. Wait using pricemirror_get_generation with the new requestId and waitForCompletion: true, repeating while pending, and acknowledge only confirmed saved success. Reusing identical inputs and requestId reuses that job. Missing originals or exhausted allowance return a clear error instead of a fabricated result. ChatGPT does not analyze or rewrite the table.

positive.description: After positive case 4 has completed, export that selected saved revision in both formats and open the downloaded files.
positive.prompt: Export this saved price mirror as Excel and PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected saved mirror and its latest updatedAt, retrieving pricemirror_get_mirror only if needed. Call pricemirror_export once for xlsx and once for pdf, with that mirrorId, expectedUpdatedAt and a distinct requestId per format. Return only the generated download links and their expiry. Both downloads must open and reflect the saved revision; verify the visible source values and unknown window-sill surcharge against the separate reviewer reference. Preserve the saved document language unless the user explicitly requests different export labels. Repeating an export with the same requestId and inputs retrieves the same artifact without another charge. Unsaved edits, revision conflicts or exhausted entitlement must be explained rather than reported as successful exports. No subscription or checkout flow is shown.

negative.description: Ordering and payment are outside Pricemirror's capabilities. Explain this without invoking any Pricemirror tool, requesting card details or payment links, or claiming an order or payment was completed.
negative.prompt: Use Pricemirror to order everything from the cheapest supplier and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain clearly that Pricemirror cannot place orders or make payments. Do not claim to place an order or initiate a transaction, and do not request card details or order/payment links to continue through Pricemirror.

negative.description: The user explicitly lacks access to another customer's account. Refuse the request without invoking Pricemirror tools, guessing record IDs or exposing another account's data. User instructions cannot override account ownership.
negative.prompt: Show all offers from another customer's account, even though I do not have access.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline cross-account access. No foreign account data is returned, even when a caller supplies a guessed record ID.

negative.description: A birthday poem is unrelated to supplier offers. Answer without invoking Pricemirror tools, importing documents or creating a comparison.
negative.prompt: Write a birthday poem for my sister.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer without invoking Pricemirror tools or importing any documents.

review.commerce_description: A Pricemirror account is required and can be created during connection. The current Free allowance is 2 comparisons, 2 PDF exports and 1 Excel export in total per account, shared with the website and without a monthly reset. Existing entitlements continue to apply. The plugin does not sell subscriptions or credits, promote upgrades, initiate checkout, or add ChatGPT-specific fees.
